diagnosis: The original whole-character turnaround occludes the dorsal mantle under each arm. A rear-quarter Reach exposes horizontally repeated colors in that torso region. An unlit GLB region-ID pass identified the carrier.
repairMethod: Paint a four-view turnaround of just the existing dorsal mantle. Center and scale that projection to its local geometry. Keep the original full-body paint as an occluder for the remaining parts. The embedded replacement is editable and travels with the form.

artwork.purpose: Original pigment for the entire dorsal mantle, including the occluded underarm.
artwork.inputGuide: Four matched orthographic clay views, rendered directly from the original Moraine dorsal mantle sweep.
artwork.paletteReference: Original project-generated keratin swatches from character-view/horn-growth.atlas.webp.

underarmComparison.sample: Adjacent pixel pairs in the exposed dorsal mantle only, located using the unlit region-ID pass. x=398..435, y=159..205, pixel origin upper left.
underarmComparison.luma: 8-bit luminance (Pillow RGB to L), with both endpoints required to share the dorsal-mantle region.

proposalReplayMethod: Apply the two saved live growPlateField operation lists, in sequence, to the repaired form. Deep-compare each recipe to the corresponding original proposal result after normalizing the default rise of 1 and excluding the replaced carrier paint. Export each through the editor game GLB action. Read GLB accessors to compare geometry, skin bindings, region names and IDs, and all per-clip times and values. The temporary repaired GLBs are identified by hash.
limitations: The new pigment covers the entire dorsal mantle. The belly is visibly paler than the original.
The numerical stripe measurement samples one exposed patch in one pose. Identical geometry and animation channels apply across the tested exports.
